name: flowda
description: Agent Skills for the flowda developer API: fetch a page, search the web, enumerate a site's URLs, run a published extraction template and monitor pages for change — through the hosted flowda MCP server.

FLOWDA_API_KEY.title: flowda API key
FLOWDA_API_KEY.description: API key from the flowda console; it starts with flw_ and carries the scopes (extract, search, map, watch) the agent may use.
